what: Cards (22em, 4:5) stand on a cylindrical spiral. Card i stands at angle i×32° and height i×(card height × .4), at radius 42em (perspective 75em), facing outward. The progress value advances .00325 per frame, so the cards rotate along the spiral while rising. Wheel (whole window) and drag (×5) add to the speed (up to ±.2) and it returns toward the base speed by .1 per frame, continuing in the direction last scrolled. Cards turned to the back are darkened by .25 and blurred .5em by (1−cos)/2. Beyond the board’s top and bottom edges (from center: half the board + 2x card height), they shrink and vanish with power2.inOut over a .5x card height range. It only runs while the board is on screen

options.gap: Gap between cards (multiple of card height), default .4
options.speed: Auto-spin speed (progress per frame), default .00325 — at 0 it stays still and spins once rolled
options.wheel: Speed added per 1px of wheel (÷100), default .015
options.catch: Share that returns to base speed (per frame), default .1
options.--fx-size · --fx-card-w: Card text size and width (css variables), default clamp(.5em, .75vw, 1.5em) · 22em
options.[data-fx-part=list] > [data-fx-part=card: Original card — duplicated enough to fill the board and hung along the spiral

note: The original takes wheel, touch and pointer input through GSAP Observer — the part receives wheel and pointer events directly (passive) and turns off hand response on touch devices (so phone scrolling is not blocked). The curtain that fades the top edge with a background-color gradient is placed by the consumer.

from.where: list.js 3D tornado cards (list.html case list header — values from the original 3D-tornado-cards module)
